name: Kiss yori...
source:
Aspiring novelist Masato met the voluptuous Chihiro on a beach one summer. They developed a relationship, but waned when they had to split up for work in the spring. Here Masato was tempted to take other relationships...but Chihiro wasn't giving this one up.

[Taken from [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=391]ANN[/url]]
translation:
立志成为小说家的真人在某年夏天于海滩邂逅了身材丰满的千寻。两人开始交往，却因春天时不得不为了工作分隔两地而逐渐疏远。真人在那里受到诱惑，想要发展其他关系…但千寻并不打算放弃这段感情。

[摘自[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=391]ANN[/url]]
